*   PowerShell, Bash, and Python for automation and tooling

This includes grooming backlog work and feature & task assignments to project team as well as influence technical direction across practice areas.

Comfortable diagnosing connectivity issues across hybrid environments.

*   Advanced experience authoring production Infrastructure as Code, including modular Terraform or Bicep with strong opinions on idempotency, reuse, environment parity, and safe change management
*   Proven track record designing and operating CI/CD pipelines at scale using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable tooling
